* Ring, Ring...

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Hello, Clover? Are you there?|...I don't think they're here, David.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: It's fine. Just leave a message for them.|They'll pick up the phone at some point.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: It has been a while since you left Tiltan.|I still fondly remember our clash... how you showed me mercy in the end.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I remember that too. I was surprised.|When you first walked into my class, I felt something pure in you.|You really wanted to study, even when the subject was hard.|You never gave up, even when I threw everything at you.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: But it's weird...|Out of every teacher in Tiltan, Yakir was the only one you didn't spare.|Why him?

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: The Tiltan authorities are still looking into it.|I don't have an answer either. No one does.|There was no sign of intent... no clue as to why you'd do it.|We tell ourselves it's because you didn't like him.|It's easier to believe that than to admit there was no reason at all.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Yakir was a good soul.|I had to cover his C# classes for a few years after that.|...I think I liked it a little more than teaching Game Design.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: He was a good teacher. Strict, but fair. Honest.|He was passionate about his subject.|He wanted everyone to get it.|He always saw the good in his students.|Even the reckless ones.|Even you.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Which is what makes it so hard to understand.|Why would you do this, Clover?|We may never know.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: But I know one thing.|And if you ever set foot in this college again

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: You won't come out of it alive.|That's a promise.
* (Click...)
* Ring, Ring....

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: Hello? Clover? Are you there?

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: They are probably not going to answer you.|Why would you even call them to begin with? Are you stupid?

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: Let me be hopeful.|I want to believe they are still out there, somewhere.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: Anyway, we just wanted to call you to say a couple of things.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: First, we want to say that we forgive you.|We know you had your reasons, and we don't hold it against you.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: I don't know if I can forgive you.|But I do know that I will never forget you.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: Second, we want to say that we hope you are doing well.|We hope you are happy, wherever you are.|I know David could be harsh. Harder on his students than he needed to be.|Maybe something happened between you two. Maybe that doesn't excuse it.|But I don't want to believe you did it for no reason at all.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Yakir, I still don't understand the point of this call.|Are you seriously thinking this person has any shred of goodness?

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: I... don't know, honestly.|But when they first walked into my class, they were just a student.|I could tell their intentions were good. They truly wanted to learn.|So why did it end so differently for David?

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: Are you really still asking these questions?|Questions. That is all you left us with, Clover.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: I am sorry if you feel like I am wasting your time, Dor...|......|But I grew attached to Clover.|We had a real bond. A student and their teacher.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: I understand.|But I don't think you should be calling them.|They are not the same person you knew.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: I know, Dor...|Maybe you are right about all of this.|But if there is even a small chance they can hear me, then I want to try.

lines.speaker: dorbendor
lines.text: ...Fine.|Say what you need to say.|I won't stop you.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: Clover.|I don't know who you are anymore.|But I still remember who you were when you walked into my class.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: That student is someone I was proud of.|And I am still proud of them. Even now.|Even after everything that happened.

lines.speaker: yakir
lines.text: I don't think I will call again. I think we both know that.|So take care of yourself, Clover.|Wherever you ended up.
* (Click...)
* Ring, Ring....
